text.body: ॥ candramaulīśvara bhujaṅgastotram ॥ sadāmudāya divyamānase saroruhāntare vihāraṇeṣu sañcayaṃ vidāriṇe cidātmane । nirastatoya toyamañci kāyakāyaśāline namaśśivāya sāmba śaṅkarāya candramaulaye ॥ 1 namo namoṣṭamūrtaye namo samānakīrtaye namo namo mahātmane namaśśubhapradāyine। namo dayārdrasetave namostu kṛttivāsase nama ... ॥ 2 pitāmahādyavedyakasvabhāvake mamāyate samastadevatā samaprapūjitāṅghricarcite । bhavāya śakraratnasadguṇaprabhāvaśāline nama ... ॥ 3 śivohamasmi bhāvayan śivaṃ śivena rakṣasa śśiva svapūrṇavarcasa svamarcase padadvayam । śivatparaṃ na vidyate śive jagatpravartane nama ... ॥ 4 kapardine'rkacandramaḥ kṛpīṭayonisandṛśe tapodhanāgraṇīmanassarojasatyavāsine । phaṇāphaṇicchabijvaladbhujaṅgabhūṣaṇāñcite nama ...॥ 5 śivānanāravindasanmilindabhāvibhāsvine vinodine dineśakoṭidikprabhākṛtāyine । svasīdasāmba sādarāvalokanaikavartine nama ...॥ 6 jaṭātaṭīluṭhadvayaddhunīgalaṃ galadhvaniddhagarjitograbuddhi sambhramabhramacchikhaṇḍine। vikhaṇḍitārimaṇḍalapracaṇḍago triśūline nama ... ॥ 7 akharvagarvadurvijṛmbhakumbhidambhadānavaṃ jitenataddhanatrinākacāriṇe vihāriṇe । sudṛksudṛkṣu hṛcchayāpahariṇe vidāriṇe nama ...॥ 8 akhaṇḍitāṇḍabāhudaṇḍadantitopradindhimapradinddhimiddhimi dhvani pramoditogratāṇḍavam । vidhāpine dhanādhinātha sādhusakhyadāyite nama ... ॥ 9 prahṛṣṭaruṣṭaduṣṭapuṣṭa diṣṭaviṣṭapāyasaṃ namadviśiṣṭa bhaktaciṣṭakīrtayeṣṭamūrtaye । yatheṣṭadaṣṭaśailajādharoṣṭapallavāya te sadānama ... || 10 harāya vā harāya vājanandinandine vinodine sanātanāya bhūtanāyarāyate । yatīśvareśvarāya śāśvatāya viśvarūpiṇe nama ... ॥ 11 bhavāya divyavaibhavāya nāyanāgnihṛṣṭahṛdbhavāya bhūri bhūmabhṛddhanurdharāya vardhine । samṛdbhiruddhimṛddhanupramṛddhavanditāya te nama ...॥ 12 marandatundilāravindasundarasmitānanonmilindabṛnda bālanīlajālaśailakuntalā । kalākalāpaśāline śivāmapekṣatoṣaṇe nama ...॥ 13 ॥iti śrīmacchaṅkarānandācāryaviracitaṃ śrīcandramaulīśvarabhujaṅgastotram ॥
